The '''Commando special rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic commandos]] of the Old Republic. It was sawed-off to reduce weight, but it delivered as much punch as a [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]]. It's only drawback was reduced ammunition.
